description: Results of the shared robustness test design/robustness_test.json (harness design/robustness.py): one entry per controller, keyed by its name, with the per-draw runs per scenario and the summary. success = the pass rule over the 64 Monte Carlo draws (the nominal draw is reported separately); over_successes: statistics over the passing Monte Carlo runs. Units: s, V, A, m, deg.
